comments.body:
Can discover Antares (Astronomy) in Gulf of Guinea which Adept of Age (15 Century-P. 1).

This discovery is required to get Scorpion Shine in Heaven quest at Lisbon, Seville, Tunis, or Marseilles

comments.author: Alchie
comments.body:
This map can't be charted with only Recognition and Fishing. Battling NPC, Trading (50/100), Shipwreck, or Discovery is needed.

The good thing is, there is a low skill Geography quest from Cape Town called Road to the Empire.

Is there any sea area with this requirements? If yes, can it be solved via low skilled quest?
